title: /harness/branch/[branch]/[...at]/shells
responsibility: Shows the shells of this repository at a branch tip or a selected commit, to search, order and open.

outputs.name: +page
outputs.description: The route's rendered Svelte markup is composed with HarnessScreen using the fixed title Shells and ExplorerCatalogScreen as its content. This file declares no route inputs, so its markup is not selected from branch or commit data here.

outputs.name: title
outputs.description: The fixed title string passed to HarnessScreen for this page. This file does not derive the title from route data.
